name: perf (web-vitals + lighthouse + server xhprof)
description: Adds .perfrc.json and server-profile.php for two-layer performance testing against a running WordPress environment: lab Core Web Vitals (web-vitals attribution build under headless Chromium) + Lighthouse performance scores, and optional server-side xhprof function profiling via WP-CLI. The server layer needs `composer require --dev rtcamp/wp-dev-tools` (not on Packagist — add it via a path or VCS repository) and the xhprof or tideways_xhprof PHP extension in the WP-CLI environment; without either it degrades gracefully rather than erroring.

inputs.description: Base URL of the WordPress environment to test against (e.g. http://localhost:8888).
Path of a post or page to test, appended to base_url (e.g. /hello-world/ or a permalink path).
Path of the search-results page to test, appended to base_url.
Optional path of one more page to test, appended to base_url. Omitted when empty; add further URLs directly in .perfrc.json.
Enable the server-side xhprof layer (needs rtcamp/wp-dev-tools and the xhprof/tideways_xhprof PHP extension in the WP-CLI environment). One of true/false/yes/no.
Project path inside the WP-CLI environment, as `wp-env run cli --env-cwd` expects it (e.g. wp-content/plugins/my-plugin, or `.` to profile from the WordPress root).

npm.profile:server: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") -- wp eval-file server-profile.php
